body_markdown:
*New online purchasing capabilities support broader market adoption; Company to showcase LaserSlat SAVER at FABTECH® 2026 and EuroBLECH 2026*


**LaFox, IL | October 19, 2026** –[Richardson Electronics, Ltd](https://www.rell.com/) . (NASDAQ: RELL), a global leader in the aftermarket of industrial laser consumables, today announced the launch of e-commerce capabilities for select LaserSlat SAVER® products on rellaser.com, expanding the Company’s digital sales capabilities and providing U.S. customers with a more direct and convenient purchasing option. The Company also announced that[LaserSlat SAVER](https://www.rellaser.com/slat-cleaning) is now available across a broad range of European markets.


LaserSlat SAVER is Richardson Electronics’ eco-friendly preventative maintenance solution designed to help reduce slag buildup on laser cutting machine slats. By helping maintain cleaner slats, the solution supports consistent cutting performance, reduces maintenance requirements, minimizes downtime, and extends the useful life of laser cutting table components. LaserSlat SAVER is compatible with all laser cutting machines and performs effectively on high-power fiber lasers up to 100 kW.


Adding online purchasing expands[Richardson Electronics’](https://www.rellaser.com/) digital sales capabilities and provides an additional channel to reach customers in the laser-cutting market. The e-commerce functionality complements the Company’s existing direct sales and technical support capabilities and makes it easier for U.S. customers to research and purchase select[LaserSlat SAVER products](https://www.rellaser.com/slat-cleaning) online. Expanded availability across European markets provides more European fabricators access to the product through Richardson Electronics’ established European infrastructure and supports the Company’s strategy to grow its recurring consumables business.


“Expanding our digital sales capabilities and European availability gives more customers convenient access to LaserSlat SAVER and helps us broaden the product’s reach in the laser cutting market,” said Claudio Schutz, Vice President and General Manager of the Industrial Components Group at Richardson Electronics. “We see continued opportunity to build awareness and adoption of LaserSlat SAVER among fabricators seeking to reduce maintenance, increase uptime, ensure part quality, and maximize equipment utilization.”


Richardson Electronics will showcase LaserSlat SAVER at[EuroBLECH 2026](https://www.euroblech.com/en-gb.html) , October 20–23, 2026, at the Hanover Exhibition Grounds in Hanover, Germany. The Company will exhibit at Booth 11-F166, where attendees can learn more about LaserSlat SAVER and the Company’s expanding portfolio of premium aftermarket parts and consumables for industrial laser systems. Richardson Electronics will also showcase LaserSlat SAVER at[FABTECH 2026](https://www.fabtechexpo.com/) , October 21–23, 2026, at the Las Vegas Convention Center in Las Vegas, Nevada. The Company will exhibit at Booth C2422, where attendees can meet with Richardson Electronics’ laser experts and learn how LaserSlat SAVER, power grid tubes, and a broad portfolio of[laser consumables](https://www.rellaser.com/) , including laser optics, nozzles and accessories, dust collection filters, bellows, service parts, and other consumables for industrial laser systems, can support preventive maintenance programs and operational performance for CO2 and fiber laser cutting equipment.


FABTECH is North America’s largest metal forming, fabricating, welding, and finishing event, and EuroBLECH is a leading international exhibition for sheet metal working. Both events provide Richardson Electronics with an opportunity to engage directly with manufacturers and fabricators seeking technologies that can improve equipment productivity, reduce operating costs, and extend equipment life.


For more information about LaserSlat SAVER and Richardson Electronics’ laser products and solutions, to purchase select products online in the U.S., or to confirm availability in your European market, visit www.rellaser.com.


**About Richardson Electronics, Ltd.**


Richardson Electronics, Ltd. is a leading global manufacturer of engineered solutions, green energy products, power grid and microwave tubes and related consumables; power conversion and RF and microwave components; CT X-ray tubes; and customized display solutions. More than 50% of our products are manufactured in LaFox, Illinois, Marlborough, Massachusetts, Donaueschingen, Germany, or by one of our manufacturing partners throughout the world. All our partners manufacture to our strict specifications and per our supplier code of conduct. We serve customers in alternative energy, healthcare, aviation, broadcast, communications, industrial, marine, medical, military, scientific and semiconductor markets. The Company’s strategy is to provide specialized technical expertise and “engineered solutions” based on our core engineering and manufacturing capabilities. The Company provides solutions and adds value through design-in support, systems integration, prototype design and manufacturing, testing, logistics and aftermarket technical service and repair through its global infrastructure. More information is available at[www.rell.com](https://www.rell.com/) .


Richardson Electronics, Ltd. common stock trades on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the ticker symbol RELL.
